title: StitchVector 3.0 line-error triage: classification rules, pushed and remote-verified before the triage runs on the target data
nature: read-only diagnosis of the frozen M0 (B2c, 37d81b7) and M2 (sv_pa, 1fee542) on ALREADY-VIEWED data; nothing is tuned, no method is changed, not a blind test

data.u2: u2 centre 300x300 (Oracle traces and PN1/PN2 as reference; Oracle does not trace text or symbols)

A_band_decomposition.scope: line length inside each band zone (band axis buffered to width/2 + 1.5 px), with legal ink (truth ink axes buffered to width/2 + 2 px) removed first, for M0 and M2

classes.centreline: line sample within 1.5 px of the band axis and tangent within 30 deg of it: a narrow-band centreline, geometry reusable after re-width + line-to-face
classes.side_edge: not centreline, within 1 px of the band side (|d - width/2| <= 1) and tangent within 30 deg: the band's own edge drawn as a line (fill-edge style false line)
classes.crossing_non_ink: tangent more than 30 deg from the band axis and not truth ink: a false line crossing the band

also: axis_reusable_centreline_share: share of band axis samples with a matching centreline in runs >= 5 px (sv_g3 rule)
F0_face_outline_share: share of the band axis whose two sides are matched by F0 face edges with a band-dedicated face (sv_g3 classify_band face_ok): the band boundary still exists in the face layer
logical groups with >= 10 px inside the band that also extend >= 10 px outside it, and those that also run >= 10 px along truth ink (wrong grouping across the band)

B_M2_additions.synthetic: length of M2-added segments that pass the luminance check, by truth label (sv_b2b.label: true_line / fill_edge / band_edge / other) and the part of it on the pale line (effective pale gain)
B_M2_additions.scenes: same with sv_b2c.label_scene label and ink sub-type
B_M2_additions.u2: M2-added parts farther than 3 px from every Oracle trace, per segment: near_dark_ink (a dark L* < 50 component of >= 10 px within 2 px: likely text or symbol ink not traced by Oracle), along_face_boundary (>= 60% of samples matched by F0 face edges), unexplained; with zoom images. Not called false lines.

C_miss_attribution.per_sample: visible truth ink samples (1 px) missed by M2 (owner-credited, sv_ld_compare.visible_recall) are assigned the FIRST failing stage, in this order

classes.found_off_or_not_credited: an M2 line lies within 4 px but the sample is not credited (off by > 2 px, or the pixel belongs to another line / crossing zone)
classes.no_candidate: neither the Lab candidate mask (hysteresis 8/12) nor the grey candidate mask (5/8) lies within width/2 + 1 px
classes.luminance_removed: an M2-added segment rejected by the luminance check lies within 2 px
classes.protected_no_grey: Lab candidate present but every such pixel is fill-protected, and no grey candidate (the case M2 cannot rescue)
classes.skeleton_join_minlen: a usable candidate is present (grey, or unprotected Lab) but no drawn chain of that path lies within 2 px (lost in skeleton / spur / join / min_len)
classes.drawn_cut_by_overlap: a grey drawn chain lies within 2 px but is not in the M2 output (cut away as overlap with B2c within add_r, or removed as < min_len after the cut)

groups.scenes: ink sub-type (dark, pale_darker, pale_brighter_than_both_sides, pale_brighter_than_one_side, boundary_dark, boundary_pale, mix_colour_on_boundary)
groups.u2: G1, G2, G3, red_tooth, red_other (Oracle traces)

C_miss_attribution.also: M0 and M2 recall per group; gaps >= 10 px in M2

outputs: protabl_triage/tri_result.json; local zoom images of the u2 far segments (pre-push hook: images not pushed)
stop_rule: one run on the target data; no rule change after the first number; no new detector, no change to B0 / B2c / M2
pre_freeze_smoke: run on dev seeds 1201 / 1301 only (not the target data) to check the code runs; one fix before freeze: sv_ld_stages.owner_map needs >= 2 truth lines, so sv_tri.owner falls back to a single-owner map for one-line scenes. No rule changed.
